assessment.summary: This is a review article (Current Opinion in Insect Science, 2025) summarizing recent research on the genomics of urban adaptation in mosquitoes, including Anopheles gambiae, An. coluzzii, An. arabiensis, An. stephensi, and An. funestus. It discusses insecticide resistance mechanisms and target-site markers such as Vgsc, Ace-1, and Rdl, but does not present any new empirical genotype data or field collections.
